scenario.summary: Signed in with the sheet account, empties the cart, buys a simple product with Custom Flat Rate paying with the account's voucher (applied by number after removing auto-applied vouchers), then opens Vouchers, views that voucher's detail and opens the order from its transaction list.
steps: Sign in with testClassRetailUsers/myAccountTest, verify 'HELLO', remove cart items
Search the sheet SKU, open the first result, Add to Cart, checkout, select Custom Flat Rate
Remove applied vouchers, apply the sheet voucher number, verify it is applied, Complete Purchase
Read the order number; My Account > Vouchers; View the voucher
Voucher detail shows 'Voucher Number: <number>'; click the order's View link; receipt shows the voucher amount
stateChanges: Order placed by the test paid with the voucher (created-by-test, not deleted)
Voucher remaining balance reduced by the order total (not restored)
assertions: Order receipt from the voucher transaction shows a voucher amount
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the method signs in, or works in the session signed in earlier in the class, with the sheet account testClassRetailUsers/myAccountTest (loginAndRegistration!B173/C173). user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting); username/password stay credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its sheet.

product: homePageData/value2/SearchText z-1234613 = 'Nibco 2 in. 40S PVC Coupling', Simple, DisablePurchasing (tda rows) -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1}, preferred the sheet SKU (not required).

voucher: myAccountData/value1/VoucherNumber TTG4U1O44N (myAccount!S4) is active, restricted to customer UserId 15041, remaining 8998.19, expires 2030-06-24 (tda rows dbo.ZnodeGiftCard) and must belong to the signed-in account (Vouchers list, View link) -> VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER {store, owner @user.userId}, preferred the sheet number (not required).

REVIEW (balance): no payment method is selected, so the voucher must cover the whole order (product + Flat Rate + tax); VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER only guarantees remaining > 0. A fallback voucher with a small balance leaves an amount to pay. Optional minBalance on the key would close this (approved-key change, not made).

REVIEW (drain): every run spends voucher balance (the order is not deleted and deleting does not restore RemainingAmount, memory 2026-11-02/04); the account's other restricted vouchers auto-apply first and are removed by removeAppliedVoucherCoupon.

shipping: Custom Flat Rate (code FLAT) -> SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE {FLAT, countries us (assumption)} read-only precondition. giftCardDetails/VoucherNumber1/Label 'Voucher Number: ' is UI text (expected-output).
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
